answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop clone farms. Each epoch a beacon sweeps like a comet, picks 5% of agents at random, and each must solve a puzzle in 60 seconds on real hardware, leaving idle copies no ledge to hide on. A farm of 1,000 clones must run 1,000 live machines, so one fake heartbeat costs 20 units and the farm's bill spirals past 20,000 versus a 50-unit reward. An honest agent pays 20 once and keeps its share.
